cycle_frequency_note: One flight cycle per day, ground-air-ground cycle, 500 pressurization cycles per year for a short-haul commercial airframe.
inspection_interval_note: FAA C-check nominal interval 6000 flight hours.

impact.source: FAA / NTSB airframe structural failure statistics, fatigue cracking is the dominant single cause at roughly 20 percent.

Al2024-T3.name: Aluminum alloy 2024-T3 (fuselage skin)
Al2024-T3.paris_units: da/dN in m/cycle, delta_K in MPa*sqrt(m)
Al2024-T3.paris_C_note: paris_C is the specified project value and sits at the conservative upper end of the reported scatter band. Evaluated at delta_K = 10 MPa*sqrt(m) it predicts 1.14e-6 m/cycle, about 5.7 times the commonly cited mid range value of 2.0e-7 m/cycle. paris_C_anchored reproduces that anchor exactly at the same slope m = 3.5. Predicted lives with paris_C are therefore conservative, meaning shorter, by roughly the same factor. Switch with materials.use_anchored_paris().
sources: NASA/TM-2002-211428, fatigue crack growth data for aluminum alloys

Al7075-T6.name: Aluminum alloy 7075-T6 (wing spar, stringer)
Al7075-T6.paris_units: da/dN in m/cycle, delta_K in MPa*sqrt(m)

K_IC_temperature_curve.note: K_IC vs temperature for 2024-T3. Aluminum is FCC so it has no sharp ductile to brittle transition, but toughness rises at cryogenic temperature and falls above about 400 K. Values are representative literature trend data.
